summary: Resource teardown for a pointer-array struct. First resets the text-format struct via TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70, then runs four two-iteration countdown loops that free eight pointer slots spaced at a 5-dword stride below the anchors this+43, this+33, this+23 and this+13, each slot freed only when non-null through FreeWrapper_7bcf. Finally frees the main pointer field at this+0 when non-null. Invoked by GlobalListTripleCleanupWithTimerRemoval (00414210) and DrawableResourceCleanup (004150C0).

operations.description: Reset the text-format struct by calling TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70 before any pointer-field teardown.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+43: each iteration loads the slot 5 dwords below the current anchor, frees it via FreeWrapper_7bcf when non-null, and steps the anchor down by 5.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+33: frees the two 5-dword-strided pointer slots below it when non-null.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+23: frees the two 5-dword-strided pointer slots below it when non-null.
Two-iteration countdown loop from anchor this+13: frees the two 5-dword-strided pointer slots below it when non-null.
Guard on the main pointer field at this+0: it is freed only when non-null.
Free the main pointer field at this+0 via FreeWrapper_7bcf when the guard passes.
Return the original main pointer value (null when the final free was skipped).
Invoked as a shared teardown helper by GlobalListTripleCleanupWithTimerRemoval (00414210) and DrawableResourceCleanup (004150C0).

unresolved: Identity of the nine pointer fields (which owned resources they reference) is not established; the loop slot offsets are dword-slot displacements, not verified byte field offsets.
TextFormatStructInitializer_4d70 is called with no visible arguments in the raw source; whether it acts on this or on a global is unresolved.
